status: adopted; new source not yet submitted

environment.cpu: Intel Core i9-14900K, P-Core CPU12 final, CPU4/8 preliminary and independent checks; E-Cores excluded
environment.seed_note: Only temporary headers replace steady_clock seed. Production seed/64-bit priorities unchanged.
environment.method: 6 paired rounds = three full64 seeds twice, interleaved baseline/control/splitlazy/combined; control is the identical baseline executable. main and shared I/O are frozen. Child output hashes match official expected values.

adopted: compact split k=0/length returns the unchanged whole subtree without boundary descent, preserving pending actions and reversals
compact flip toggles reversal and swaps noncommutative aggregates now; child links swap only at push, allowing canceled reversals to avoid link writes
compact trivially copyable S/F slots need only a free-list link at recycle; allocate reconstructs the whole slot before reuse. Noncompact ownership cleanup remains unchanged
unchanged: Public API, full64 priority ordering, seeded production RNG policy, reserve/overflow checks, ownership, IDs and generic fallback layout
Existing compact64B+aux8B layout and deferred own-value mapping
No new SIMD/CPU dispatch: dependent single-node walks do not justify an added specialized SIMD path here. Standard C++23 implementation.

callback_counts.measurement: callback and internal operation counts only; not performance timing

callback_scope: Counters compare baseline and splitlazy (without recycle omission); pure reverse and update paths are identical to final combined. Mixed e/id counts are not final counts. Instrumentation is excluded from timing.

rejected.reason: Dedicated apply prefix/suffix improved standalone apply modestly but produced 1-2.5% mixed/reverse regressions; push flag snapshot did not win consistently; split wrapper was inferior to compact endpoint returns.

extra_push_and_query_rejected.reason: Immediate return fixes pure query but regresses reverse or apply/mixed; query-only compact guard bloats query code and regresses mixed by2.9%. Preserve adopted combined.

from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,random,time,json,statistics,hashlib
p=Path('/tmp/treap_next');r=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');os.sched_setaffinity(0,{12});ccs={'gcc':['/usr/bin/g++'],'clang':['clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15']};variants=['baseline','splitlazy','combined'];builds=[]
seed='        return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count());'
for v in variants:
 s='#include <cstdlib>\n'+(p/f'{v}.hpp').read_text().replace(seed,'        return std::strtoull(std::getenv("TREAP_SEED"), nullptr, 0);')
 (p/f'{v}-fixed.hpp').write_text(s)
 for kind in ['main','micro','generic']:
  src='#define SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n'+s+'\n'+(r/'Verify/current/drivers/implicit_treap_affine_main.cpp').read_text()if kind=='main'else(p/'repro/benchmark-fixtures'/('micro.cpp'if kind=='micro'else'generic_micro.cpp')).read_text().replace('#include "selected.hpp"','#include "'+str(p/f'{v}-fixed.hpp')+'"')
  path=p/f'final-{v}-{kind}.cpp';path.write_text(src)
  for comp,cc in ccs.items():
   exe=p/f'final-{comp}-{v}-{kind}';cmd=cc+['-std=c++23','-O2','-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS','-I'+str(r),str(path),'-o',str(exe)];q=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);assert q.returncode==0,q.stderr
   builds.append(dict(compiler=comp,variant=v,kind=kind,command=cmd,sha256=hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
(p/'final-builds.json').write_text(json.dumps(builds,indent=2));print('build done',flush=True)
# Wait for explicit quiet-window signal, after independent review/compiles complete.
while not(p/'quiet.ready').exists():time.sleep(1)
rows=[];rng=random.Random(187512);vv=['baseline','control','splitlazy','combined'];expected=json.loads(next(p.glob('library-checker-problems-*')).joinpath('data_structure/dynamic_sequence_range_affine_range_sum/hash.json').read_text());inputs=sorted((p/'inputs').glob('*.in'))
for rep in range(6):
 env=dict(os.environ,TREAP_SEED=hex([0x185f91e4a30c721b,0x614a90d237fec815,0xb1739f8064a25dc7][rep%3]))
 for comp in ccs:
  for inp in inputs:
   vs=vv.copy();rng.shuffle(vs)
   for v in vs:
    actual='baseline'if v=='control'else v;t=time.perf_counter()
    with inp.open('rb')as f:x=subprocess.run([str(p/f'final-{comp}-{actual}-main')],stdin=f,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,env=env,check=True)
    dt=time.perf_counter()-t;h=hashlib.sha256(x.stdout).hexdigest();assert h==expected[inp.stem+'.out'];rows.append(dict(rep=rep,compiler=comp,fixture='official',name=inp.stem,variant=v,seconds=dt,checksum=h))
  conditions=[('micro',262144,30000,i,0)for i in range(14)]+[('micro',16,20000,i,0)for i in [1,2,3,4,9]]+[('generic',262144,20000,i,t)for t in [0,1]for i in [3,4,9]]
  for kind,n,q,mode,typ in conditions:
   if mode==0:q=262144
   if mode==13:q=16
   vs=vv.copy();rng.shuffle(vs)
   for v in vs:
    actual='baseline'if v=='control'else v;x=subprocess.run([str(p/f'final-{comp}-{actual}-{kind}'),str(n),str(q),str(mode),str(typ)],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,check=True);sec,chk=x.stdout.split();rows.append(dict(rep=rep,compiler=comp,fixture=kind,name=f'n{n}-mode{mode}-type{typ}',variant=v,seconds=float(sec),checksum=chk))
 (p/'final-raw.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2));print('final rep',rep,flush=True)
summary=[];keys=sorted({(x['compiler'],x['fixture'],x['name'])for x in rows})
for comp,fixture,name in keys:
 rr=[x for x in rows if(x['compiler'],x['fixture'],x['name'])==(comp,fixture,name)];assert len({x['checksum']for x in rr})==1
 row=dict(compiler=comp,fixture=fixture,name=name,ratios={},medians={})
 for v in vv:
  row['ratios'][v]=statistics.median(next(x['seconds']for x in rr if x['rep']==i and x['variant']==v)/next(x['seconds']for x in rr if x['rep']==i and x['variant']=='baseline')for i in range(6));row['medians'][v]=statistics.median(x['seconds']for x in rr if x['variant']==v)
 summary.append(row)
(p/'final-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(conditions=summary,runs=len(rows)),indent=2));print('DONE',len(rows),flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,os,hashlib
p=Path('/tmp/treap_next/counts');r=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');up=Path('/tmp/treap_next')
fields=['op','mapping','composition','e','id','split','split_nonempty','split_empty','split_zero_return','split_length_return','push','push_action','push_reversal','pull','flip','flip_nonempty','child_swap','act','act_nonempty','merge']
stat='''#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\nstruct OperationCounts {\n'''+''.join('std::uint64_t '+f+'=0;\n'for f in fields)+'''~OperationCounts() { std::fprintf(stderr,"{'''+','.join('\\"'+f+'\\":%llu'for f in fields)+'''}\\n",'''+','.join('(unsigned long long)'+f for f in fields)+'''); }\n} counts;\n'''
driver=(r/'Verify/current/drivers/implicit_treap_affine_main.cpp').read_text();main=driver[driver.index('int main()'):]
for f,anchor in [('op','static S op(S x, S y) {'),('mapping','static S mapping(F f, S x) {'),('composition','static F composition(F f, F g) {'),('e','static S e() {'),('id','static F id() {')]:
 assert driver.count(anchor)==1;driver=driver.replace(anchor,anchor+' ++counts.'+f+';')
assert driver[driver.index('int main()'):]==main
sources={}
for variant in ['baseline','splitlazy']:
 source=(up/(variant+'.hpp')).read_text();sources[variant]=hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest()
 source=source.replace('return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count());','return std::strtoull(std::getenv("SIRKIT_BENCH_SEED"),nullptr,0);')
 for field,anchor in [('push','void push(int p) {'),('pull','void pull(int p) {'),('act','void act(int p, F f) {'),('flip','void flip(int p) {'),('split','std::pair<int, int> split(int p, int k) {'),('merge','int merge(int a, int b) {')]:
  assert source.count(anchor)==1;extra=' ++counts.'+field+';'
  if field in ['act','flip']:extra+=' if (p >= 0) ++counts.'+field+'_nonempty;'
  if field=='split':extra+=' if (p >= 0) ++counts.split_nonempty; else ++counts.split_empty;'
  source=source.replace(anchor,anchor+extra)
 for anchor,field in [('if (has_action(p)) {','push_action'),('if (n.pending) {','push_action'),('if (has_reversal(p)) {','push_reversal'),('if (n.reversed) {','push_reversal')]:
  # has_action/reversal parent braces only in push; no other uses same form in current sources.
  source=source.replace(anchor,anchor+' ++counts.'+field+';')
 source=source.replace('std::swap(n.left, n.right);','(++counts.child_swap, std::swap(n.left, n.right));')
 source=source.replace('if (k == 0) return {-1, p};','if (k == 0) { ++counts.split_zero_return; return {-1, p}; }')
 source=source.replace('if (k == length(p)) return {p, -1};','if (k == length(p)) { ++counts.split_length_return; return {p, -1}; }')
 src=p/(variant+'.cpp');src.write_text('#define SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n'+stat+source+'\n'+driver)
 subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/g++','-std=c++23','-O2','-I'+str(r),str(src),'-o',str(p/variant)],check=True)
 print('built',variant,flush=True)
expected=json.loads(next(up.glob('library-checker-problems-*/data_structure/dynamic_sequence_range_affine_range_sum/hash.json')).read_text());rows=[]
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{4})
for seed in [0x185f91e4a30c721b,0x614a90d237fec815,0xb1739f8064a25dc7]:
 for case in ['max_02','max_03','max_random_00']:
  for variant in ['baseline','splitlazy']:
   with (up/'inputs'/(case+'.in')).open('rb')as h:x=subprocess.run([str(p/variant)],stdin=h,capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,SIRKIT_BENCH_SEED=hex(seed)),check=True)
   check=hashlib.sha256(x.stdout).hexdigest();assert check==expected[case+'.out'],(case,variant,check)
   row={'seed':hex(seed),'case':case,'variant':variant,'source_sha256':sources[variant],'output_sha256':check,'counts':json.loads(x.stderr)};rows.append(row);print(case,variant,hex(seed),row['counts'],flush=True)
summary=[]
for case in ['max_02','max_03','max_random_00']:
 rr=[x for x in rows if x['case']==case];totals={v:{f:sum(x['counts'][f]for x in rr if x['variant']==v)for f in fields}for v in ['baseline','splitlazy']};summary.append({'case':case,'totals_3_seeds':totals,'ratios':{f:totals['splitlazy'][f]/totals['baseline'][f]if totals['baseline'][f]else None for f in fields}})
(p/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source_hashes':sources,'main_sha256':hashlib.sha256(main.encode()).hexdigest(),'measurement':'callback and internal operation counts only; not performance timing','seeds':[hex(x)for x in [0x185f91e4a30c721b,0x614a90d237fec815,0xb1739f8064a25dc7]],'rows':rows,'summary':summary},indent=2));print('DONE',flush=True)
